rationale: Reconnaissance task: load_tables and schema_summary produce the per-table data contract (rows, columns, dtypes). missingness uses scope=all_columns because the task asks for every column of every table plus explicit all-null callouts (manifest shows dx3-dx5, modifier1/2, denial_reason_desc and auth_number fully null in medical_claims). duplicate_check tests the natural key of each table and both adherence keys so the report can show member_id alone is not unique there while member_id+therapeutic_class is. date_ranges covers all three medical_claims date columns (as required) plus pharmacy and enrollment dates that later tasks will rely on, with consistency_checks=true to count adjudication-before-service-end and end-before-start rows. join_check verifies every relationship named in the task: both claims tables and adherence to members, rendering and billing NPIs to providers, and pharmacy_npi to providers, which the manifest indicates has no matching keys and must be documented as not joinable. write_report includes the required synthetic_data and sample_preview caveats, adds descriptive_only and no_operational_use, and turns on denominators and artifact citations so every rate and number traces to a saved artifact.
